context: A mom encourages her teen daughter before a big certification
purpose: Teach: 英文/解答/検定/検出/限度/欠点/ユニーク/多々

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 明日いよいよ英検の本番ね。英文読解の問題集、もうひと通り終わった?
lines.en: Tomorrow's the big eiken exam. Have you finished one full round of the English reading workbook?
lines.style: Warm, gently checking in, motherly encouragement before a big day.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、終わったけど…解答を見直すたびに間違いが多々見つかって、ちょっと自信なくなってきた。
lines.en: Yeah, I finished, but every time I review my answers I find lots of mistakes, and I'm losing confidence.
lines.style: Teen voice, slightly defeated, honest with mom, trailing off softly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 誰だって欠点はあるのよ。むしろそれに気づけてるって、すごく大事なことなんだから。
lines.en: Everyone has weak points. Honestly, the fact that you noticed them is really important.
lines.style: Reassuring, steady, reframing weakness as meaningful growth ahead.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でもこの検定、合格率低いし…私みたいな普通の高校生が受かるのかなって。
lines.en: But this certification has a low pass rate... I wonder if an ordinary high schooler like me can really pass.
lines.style: Self-doubting, soft, fishing for reassurance from mom.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 桜の答案ってね、いつも視点がユニークで、お母さん読んでて面白いって思うのよ。
lines.en: Your answers, Sakura, always have such a unique perspective—I genuinely find them interesting when I read them.
lines.style: Sincere praise, specific, mother sharing a personal observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ほんとに?でも緊張で頭真っ白になったら、ミスが検出されまくる気がする…
lines.en: Really? But if I freeze up from nerves, I feel like every tiny mistake will get caught...
lines.style: Vulnerable, slightly joking with the verb choice, still anxious.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 緊張の限度を超えそうになったら、深呼吸して、お母さんの顔思い出しなさい。
lines.en: If your nerves are about to hit their limit, take a deep breath and picture my face.
lines.style: Calm directive, tender, giving a concrete coping tool.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: …うん。お母さんがそう言ってくれると、なんかいける気がしてきた。ありがとう。
lines.en: ...Okay. When you say it like that, I actually feel like I can do it. Thanks, Mom.
lines.style: Soft, sincere, shifting from anxious to grounded, quietly grateful.
